view: PA (frontal), "L" marker at upper right of image confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate: full inspiration (right hemidiaphragm at ~9th-10th posterior rib), minimal rotation, adequate penetration (thoracic spine visible through mediastinum); bilateral breast shadows overlie the lower zones and add mild lower-zone haze; lung apices and both costophrenic regions included

devices.location: Upper right corner of the image (patient's left upper corner, outside the thorax)

abnormalities.finding: Blunting of the costophrenic angle with homogeneous veil-like opacity and loss of the hemidiaphragm contour, consistent with a small-to-moderate pleural effusion (approximately 3-5 cm meniscus height); the left lung base sits higher than the right, so a subpulmonic component cannot be excluded
Prominent / mildly unfolded aortic knob (likely age-related aortic tortuosity)
Mildly increased bronchovascular markings, no focal consolidation, nodule or pneumothorax; right costophrenic angle sharp and right hemidiaphragm well defined

description_zh: 胸部正面（PA）X光，影像右上方可見「L」標記，患者左側位於影像右側。左側肋膈角變鈍，左下肺野呈均質性霧狀增加密度並伴有外側上揚之弧形邊緣，左側橫膈輪廓模糊，符合左側少量至中量肋膜積液（估計約4公分）；右側橫膈與肋膈角清晰，右肺野未見明顯病灶。心臟大小正常，主動脈弓略為突出，氣管居中；雙側乳房陰影重疊於下肺野。未見胸管、中央靜脈導管、心律調節器或手術夾等裝置，無已接受治療之證據。
